title: Immaculate Constellation report describes a large strategic intelligence project on UAP data
summary: Michael Shellenberger tells of Immaculate Constellation report describes a large strategic intelligence project on UAP data, about 2024 at United States (no place named), and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: certainly the Revelation that there exists a very large strategic intelligence project to evaluate this information

Michael Shallon, this journalist, just testified in front of Congress, put out this 12-page report, uh, Immaculate Constellation, this program that seemed to be some unagnowledged special access program in the US.
tellings.difference: Calls it a 12-page report on an unacknowledged special access program and links it to Shellenberger's congressional testimony; it does not say it was a large strategic intelligence project.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Michael Shellenberger's 2024 Immaculate Constellation report, told as a document he published and spoke about to Congress.

plain: A journalist named Michael Shellenberger says that in 2024 he received a report about a secret US program called Immaculate Constellation. According to Shellenberger, the report reveals a very large strategic intelligence project set up to gather and evaluate information on UAP, the official term for UFOs, which would mean the government studies the subject far more seriously than it says in public.
